$comment: Ground truth for SECOND WORLD recall/precision (docs/12-testing-and-quality.md §3). location.line = the line after the SEEDED-DEFECT marker; refresh with `node examples/_tools/sync-expected-findings.mjs examples/shop-express`. Every defect is reproduced by tests/integration/examples/shop-express.test.ts. location.symbol = enclosing exported function; location.handler = route whose handler contains the defect; location.callee = the offending call.

defects.title: N+1 query: one reviews query per product in GET /products?include=reviews
defects.reproduction: GET /products?include=reviews executes 1 + N queries (21 for 20 products); see /__test/stats
defects.fix: Load reviews for all products with db.reviewsForMany(ids) and group in memory

defects.title: Outbound call to payments without a timeout
defects.reproduction: Make payments-fake hang: POST /orders never completes

defects.title: Synchronous pbkdf2Sync in the login handler blocks the event loop
defects.reproduction: Concurrent logins delay unrelated requests (GET /healthz) by ~N x 20 ms

defects.title: Module dependency cycle: services/inventory.ts <-> services/orders.ts
defects.reproduction: Static import graph contains the cycle inventory.ts -> orders.ts -> inventory.ts
defects.fix: Move pendingQuantity into a third module or invert the dependency

defects.title: Race condition on stock decrement (check-then-await-then-write) oversells
defects.reproduction: Product 20 has stock 1; 5 concurrent POST /orders for it -> more than one 201
defects.fix: Atomic conditional decrement (compare-and-set) or a per-product lock

defects.title: Idempotency-Key ignored on POST /orders: retries create duplicate orders
defects.reproduction: Send the same POST /orders twice with the same Idempotency-Key -> two different order ids
defects.fix: Store key -> response for 24 h and replay it

defects.title: BOLA: any authenticated user can read any order via GET /orders/:id
defects.reproduction: alice creates an order; bob GETs /orders/<alice's id> -> 200 (contract: 404)
defects.fix: Return 404 unless order.userId === current user (or admin)

defects.title: Schema drift: GET /products/:id returns price as a string (contract: number)
500 on boundary quantity (qty=0, qty<0 or qty>100) instead of 400
Unbounded retry loop to payments with no backoff, jitter or attempt cap
defects.reproduction: payments failNext=25 -> one POST /orders makes 26 charge attempts back-to-back
defects.fix: Cap attempts (e.g. 3), exponential backoff with full jitter, circuit breaker

defects.title: Concurrent POST /orders with the same Idempotency-Key each create an order
defects.description: DISCOVERED, not planted: found by the Adversarial Test Agent (idempotency-concurrent technique) and kept as ground truth. Here it is a consequence of idempotency-ignored (the key is never read, so sequential repeats duplicate too).
defects.reproduction: Send 5 concurrent POST /orders with one Idempotency-Key -> more than one distinct order id
defects.fix: Make key reservation atomic: insert the key (unique) before doing the work, or a per-key lock; concurrent duplicates wait for and replay the first response
